pages.title: Absolute Notes I
pages.text: The first of the final volumes: axioms, paradoxes, the Banach-Tarski sphere that doubles itself, and Godel's sentence that says it cannot be proven. It is a notebook about the foundations of thought, written by someone standing on them while they shake.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex required notes about the rules beneath the rules. I fed an axiom fragment, paradox residue, an axiomatic field emitter, a white hole fragment, a Banach-Tarski sphere and a Godel sentence into the line, and the first absolute volume came out signed.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.
